title.en: An Act Providing the Method of Executing Leases of Government Buildings or Cottages.
title.orig: An Act Providing the Method of Executing Leases of Government Buildings or Cottages.

text.en:
All contracts and leases for the use and occupancy of Government buildings or cottages in the
territory under the exclusive control of the Philippine Commission shall hereafter be executed by the Director
of Public Works, with the approval of the Secretary of Commerce and Police.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, January 25, 1912.
